claims.claim_text: At approximately 0044 hours, I was dispatched to Imperial - Health & Beauty, a business located at 9196 Bolsa Avenue, regarding a reported vandalism.
A male subject wearing a gray shirt had used a wooden baseball bat to repeatedly strike the front of the business and an exterior surveillance camera.
The footage captured a male wearing a gray jacket and blue jeans striking the camera with a white-colored stick or pole.
The subject was carrying a long pole in his left hand.
The subject immediately complied by stopping and placing the pole on the ground, but then quickly picked it up again and began walking westbound away from me.
Officer Kessler spoke to the subject only in English.
While walking, the subject struck a fire hydrant on the south sidewalk of 9200 Bolsa with the metal pole, producing a loud noise.
The subject turned and began walking southbound across all traffic lanes of Bolsa Avenue.
The subject raised it above his head in an overhead striking position.
The subject then charged directly toward Officer Kessler, who was closest to the subject.
I discharged my firearm three times at the subject.
Officers moved in and handcuffed the subject, who remained conscious. We immediately began rendering medical aid.
Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived at approximately 0107 hours and assumed patient care.

I drew my TASER Electronic Control Weapon and followed the subject on foot. At approximately 0057 hours, I holstered my TASER and transitioned to my service weapon as the subject continued to ignore my commands.
